record.what_it_does: A command-line tool (and Node.js library) that converts Mermaid diagram definition files into SVG, PNG, or PDF output.
record.auth_notes: Mermaid CLI is a local npm package/Docker image/Node.js API — it runs a headless Chromium instance locally to render diagrams and has no network service or credentials of any kind.
record.access_notes: Anyone can install it for free via `npm install -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli`, pull the Docker image, or use the Node.js API — no signup, account, or payment involved.
record.main_blocker: Not a hosted API — it is a local CLI/library that shells out to a headless browser, so it needs different packaging (e.g. wrapping the CLI/Node API as a local tool) rather than an OAuth/API-key toolkit action.

evidence.quote: This is a command-line interface (CLI) for mermaid. It takes a mermaid definition file as input and generates an SVG/PNG/PDF file as output.
It's possible to call mermaid-cli via a Node.JS API.
Command line tool for the Mermaid library
